query: Consider the following context: High entropy alloys have excellent wear resistance, so they have great application prospects in the fields of wear resistance and surface protection. In that context, which material can be used for adhere to the surface of a Cu matrix, and why?

generation.hypothesis: High entropy alloys can be used to adhere to the surface of a Cu matrix for wear resistance and surface protection
generation.conditions: wear resistance and surface protection applications
generation.predicted_outcome: improved wear resistance and surface protection
generation.baseline: Cu matrix without high entropy alloys
generation.boundary: wear resistance and surface protection applications
generation.falsification_experiment: comparing wear resistance of Cu matrix with and without high entropy alloys
